title: Walk Into Interviews Like You Belong There
description:
Most candidates walk into interviews hoping the company likes them. That mindset quietly destroys confidence.

You already beat hundreds of applicants to get the interview. Walk in like you belong there.

Check out the full video for the simple 6-step strategy to crush your next interview! https://youtu.be/VvaFE--lEws

#interviewtips #jobinterview #careercoach #jobsearch #interviewprep #careeradvice #jobseekers #careerstrategy
transcript: You will get rejected if you walk into your interview thinking they're doing you a favor. Most candidates lose a job before they even answer a single question because they walk in like, "Wow, I hope they like me." No, you walk in like they've already chosen me, now I'm just confirming it. You've made it through hundreds of applicants, that wasn't luck, that was a decision. If you don't believe you're the best candidate, why should they? I'm Kate Uhrscher, career strategist and your career bestie and I break down exactly how to walk into your interview as the obvious choice. And if you want the full simple six-step strategy, make sure to check out my full video and follow along.
